registry_rule: All 8 NASA-listed physical planets; all 5 NASA/IAU-recognized dwarf planets; JPL discovery-table natural satellites with both permanent IAU name and number plus a unique JPL Horizons major-body ID; Earth Moon and named Eris/Haumea dwarf satellites from JPL major-body identities; existing LOOM-registered asteroids and reference bodies. Provisional-only satellites and unrelated small bodies are excluded.
